enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Move arm. Turn onto back. Remain still. Breathe deeply.

Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on faucet. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off faucet. Use toilet. Flush. Wash hands. Take off pajamas. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wash body. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Comb hair. Turn off light. Walk out.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out bread. Take out eggs. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Press lever. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off cooker. Remove toast. Spread butter. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up. Place dishes in sink. Rinse dishes. Load dishwasher.

Enter bedroom. Pick up phone from nightstand. Press power button. Unlock phone. Check messages. Scroll through notifications. Open email. Read emails. Reply to message. Put phone in pocket. Open closet. Take out bag. Open bag. Place laptop inside. Place charger inside. Place wallet inside. Place keys inside. Zip bag. Put on jacket. Check mirror. Adjust hair. Pick up phone again. Check time. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk to subway. Descend stairs. Wait for train. Board train. Stand holding handrail. Get off train. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter workplace. Put on scrubs. Wash hands. Check patient list. Visit patient room. Take vitals. Administer medication. Update records. Consult with doctor. Assist with procedure. Sterilize equipment. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Attend meeting. Write reports.

Walk to subway. Descend stairs. Wait for train. Board train. Stand holding handrail. Get off train. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add spices. Turn off cooker. Serve food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Place dishes in sink. Rinse dishes. Load dishwasher.

Enter living room. Turn on light. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Change channels. Settle on program. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Adjust volume. Get up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return. Sit down. Continue watching. Lean back. Put feet on coffee table.

Enter bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for boot. Enter password. Open browser. Check email. Open document. Type. Scroll. Click. Open application. Video call. Talk. End call. Close laptop. Turn off desk lamp.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush. Wash hands. Turn on faucet. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Apply moisturizer. Turn off faucet. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading or using phone before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open to page. Read. Turn page. Read. Close book. Pick up phone. Unlock. Open app. Scroll. Read. Put down phone. Lie down. Adjust pillow. Close eyes.
Lie down. Pull blanket over body. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to side. Move arm. Stretch legs. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn onto back. Fall asleep.
